summary: Iteration 2 testing of AERwolf: two-stage AlgoFinder→TechFinder, HyperframePlayer with 20 seeded algorithms + LLM fallback, ComparePanel, Settings BYO OpenRouter key, and unified llm_generate helper. Ran pytest against public preview URL (18 tests) and 4 Playwright browser flows against real backend. 17/18 backend tests passed on first run; 18/18 on isolated re-runs. All critical frontend flows verified end-to-end (landing, dashboard→workspace, canvas 5 nodes/4 edges, algo drawer with 7 cards, hyperframes modal cycling 5 frames, tech finder with 7 techs and back-nav, compare modal with verdict, settings BYO key save/clear, workspace save→export SKILL.md with YAML front-matter, library list+delete with confirm dialog, model selector shows all 10 models including 4 OpenRouter).

minor.issue: Intermittently returns Cloudflare 502 when LLM latency exceeds ~100s edge timeout (observed 1 flake in a full suite run; passed on isolated re-run within 54s). Not a code bug — platform edge timeout on cold-start LLM calls.

Fuzzy substring match is overly aggressive: 'MyCustomTransformer' matches seeded 'Transformer' because the check `hkey in raw` treats 'transformer' as substring of 'mycustomtransformer'. Problem statement explicitly expects this input to hit source='generated'/'cache'. Recommend switching to word-boundary/token match (e.g. split raw on non-alphanumerics and check exact token) rather than substring.

issues: React Flow console warning: nodeTypes/edgeTypes recreated on every render (NODE_TYPES is defined at module scope but useMemo would silence the warning). Non-blocking but adds noise to logs.

action_items: Fix hyperframes fuzzy matcher: replace substring `hkey in raw` with token-level match so novel algorithms containing 'transformer' as a suffix (e.g. 'MyCustomTransformer', 'ImageTransformer') don't collide with the seeded 'Transformer' entry. Suggested: `words = set(re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', raw)); if hkey in words or entry['name'].lower() in words`.
Wrap NODE_TYPES in useMemo (or keep the module-level constant reference stable) to suppress React Flow warning in Workspace.jsx.
Consider raising the OpenRouter demo key so `provider=openrouter` model choices work out-of-the-box during preview (currently 400s with a friendly error — correct per spec but poor first-touch UX).
critical_code_review_comments: hyperframes.get_seeded fuzzy matcher: substring collisions (see action items).

server.py llm_generate handles openrouter path but re-uses the same UserMessage/LlmChat pattern for other providers; no unit-level fallback if LiteLLM raises non-HTTP exceptions before yielding (currently wrapped in a broad try/except returning 502 — acceptable).
settings PUT accepts an empty string to clear the key (business rule) — make sure this is documented in Settings.jsx tooltip so users understand the clear semantics.

Workspace.jsx: NODE_TYPES declared at module scope (good) but React Flow still warns. Also, drawer conditionally unmounts on `!techFinderAlgo` — causes an extra network fetch when TechFinder is closed via back button. Consider persisting fetched algos in Workspace state to avoid re-fetching on back-nav.

Backend /api/skills export uses LLM for narrative but silently falls back to a minimal MD on failure — good defensive coding. Consider surfacing a 'preview generated with fallback' flag so the frontend can indicate stale/basic content.

success_rate.backend: 100% on isolated reruns (17/18 on first full-suite run due to one Cloudflare 502 flake on the hyperframes LLM path)

seed_data_creation: Re-seeded users + user_sessions for test-user-aerwolf-001 at test start; cleaned up user_settings.openrouter_key, skills with TEST_ prefix, and hyperframe_cache entries created during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 18 iteration-2 features. Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cognition-engine-4.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Expect ~90-100s total. The hyperframes generated test uses a random 'Zorblax_XXX' name to avoid fuzzy-match collision — do not change to any name containing seeded keys like 'transformer', 'attention', 'diffusion', 'cnn', 'gan', 'ocr' etc. Frontend Playwright flow: session cookie must be set on domain ocr-lab.preview.emergentagent.com. Library delete uses window.confirm() — register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept()))` before clicking.
rca of the issue: Non-blocking bug: hyperframes fuzzy matcher in /app/backend/hyperframes.py:get_seeded() uses `if hkey in raw or entry['name'].lower() in raw` which is a substring test. Any input containing 'transformer', 'attention', 'diffusion', 'yolo', 'cnn', 'gan', 'rag', 'vit', 'unet', 'crnn', 'svtr', 'resnet', 'lstm', 'clahe', 'sauvola', 'otsu', 'dbnet', 'kmeans', 'pca', 'tsne' anywhere in its lowercased name will be routed to the seeded entry — even when the user intends a novel algorithm. Mitigation: tokenize input on non-alphanumeric boundaries and require whole-token equality, or add explicit deny-list for common suffixes. Reproduction: `POST /api/hyperframes {"algorithm": "MyCustomTransformer"}` returns source='seeded' with the Transformer frames, contradicting the problem-statement expectation of source='generated'.
